entities.summary: Andreas Jakob von Dietrichstein was the Prince-Archbishop of Salzburg from 1747 to 1753. He was the successor to Prince-Archbishop Liechtenstein and ruled shortly before the birth of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.
